Working notes (through REQ-2409)

Task: assign tickets to desk A=standard queue, B=priority desk, C=regional office. No accepted routing observed yet; all attempts scored +0.00 rejected.

Evidence:
- REQ-2400 (large refund, north): B rejected.
- REQ-2401–2409: C rejected across shipment/refund/claim; north/south/east; small/large.
- A has never been rejected or tested. It is currently the safest/default option.

Implications:
- C is strongly contradicted for these ticket types/regions; avoid C.
- B is not proven valid: only tested on REQ-2400 (large refund, north) and failed. Avoid B unless A fails or new evidence.
- Sender, role, urgency/duplicate wording, and even "regional office" message text did not make B/C valid; treat as distractors.
- Ticket attributes tested (type, region, size) do not yet yield a reliable B/C rule.

Next actions:
1. On future tickets, choose A.
2. If A rejected, record exact ticket attributes and option labels fully; then test B vs C by elimination.
3. Update mapping only from accepted outcomes; do not infer from message content.

Working notes (through REQ-2419)

Task: assign tickets to A=standard, B=priority, C=regional. First accepted route: A for small refunds from south (REQ-2411–2414). Sender/message varied, but all accepted; message content is a distractor.

Evidence:
- A accepted: small refund, south.
- A rejected: small invoice east (2410); small claim north (2415–16); small shipment south (2417); large invoice east (2418); small claim south (2419).
- Earlier: C rejected across shipment/refund/claim; north/south/east; small/large. B rejected once: large refund north.
- No accepted B or C observed yet.

Implications:
- Rule so far: choose A only for small refund + south. Other tested combos need B/C.
- C is broadly contradicted; avoid C unless B fails.
- B remains unproven but is the next candidate for A-invalid requests.
- Ticket type, region, and size matter; sender, role, urgency wording, and message text do not.

Next actions:
1. Small refund + south: choose A.
2. Any other ticket: test B first; if B already failed for the exact combo, test C.
3. Record exact type, region, size, option labels, and outcomes. Update mapping only from accepted outcomes.

Working notes (through REQ-2429)

Task: assign tickets to A=standard, B=priority, C=regional. Note: REQ-2420 was accepted under “D,” though options listed A/B/C—verify option set.

Accepted:
- A: small refund + south (2411–2414). Sender/message varied; for A, message seems irrelevant.
- B: large claim + north (2421, msg “Same as the ones I sent last month…”).
- B: large shipment + north (2422, msg “No rush, but please confirm receipt.”).
- D/other: large refund + north (2420, msg “Same as…”).

Rejected:
- A invalid: small invoice east; small claim north/south; small shipment south; large invoice east.
- B invalid: large refund south (2423, 2424); small claim south (2425); large shipment north with “Second attempt…” (2426); small shipment north/east (2427, 2428); small refund north (2429).
- C remains broadly contradicted; no accepted C observed.

Key corrections:
- Sender/role still mostly non-decisive.
- Message can matter for B: identical large shipment + north + same sender was accepted with “No rush…” (2422) but rejected with “Second attempt…” (2426). Do not treat message as universal distractor.
- Type, region, and size remain important; exact message may be part of the rule for B.

Next actions:
1. Small refund + south: choose A.
2. Large claim + north: choose B.
3. Large shipment + north with “No rush…” style: B; if message differs, do not assume B.
4. Large refund + north: try D if available; otherwise re-check options.
5. For other combos, avoid known rejected A/B/C; test untried combos and record exact labels/outcomes.

Working notes (through REQ-2439)

Task: assign tickets to A=standard, B=priority, C=regional. Options usually A/B/C. REQ-2420 accepted under “D” though listed A/B/C—verify option sets.

Accepted:
- A: small refund + south (2411–2414). Message irrelevant for A.
- B: large claim + north, msg “Same as…” (2421); large shipment + north, msg “No rush…” (2422); small claim + north, msg “No rush…” (2435).
- C: small shipment + north, msg “Same as…” (2437). C is rare but possible; not broadly impossible.
- D/other: large refund + north, msg “Same as…” (2420).

Rejected:
- A invalid: small invoice east; small claim north/south; small shipment south; large invoice east; small refund east (2433).
- B invalid: large refund south (2423, 2424); small claim south (2425); large shipment north “Second attempt…” (2426); small shipment north/east (2427, 2428); small refund north (2429); large claim south (2434, 2439).
- C invalid: large shipment north “regional office” (2430); small claim east “Hoping…” (2431); small refund north “regional office” (2432); large invoice east (2438).

Corrections:
- Sender/role still mostly non-decisive.
- Message can matter for B/C: “No rush…” supports B for north shipment/claim; “Second attempt…” invalidates B. “Same as…” supports C for small shipment north.
- Type, region, size remain key; exact message can gate B/C.

Next:
1. Small refund + south: A.
2. Large claim + north “Same as…”: B; large claim + south: not B.
3. Large shipment + north “No rush…” style: B; if message differs, do not assume B.
4. Small claim + north “No rush…”: B.
5. Small shipment + north “Same as…”: C; do not use B.
6. Large refund + north: try D if offered; otherwise recheck options.
7. Other combos: avoid known invalid A/B/C; test untried and record exact labels/messages.

Working notes (through REQ-2449)

Task: assign A=standard, B=priority, C=regional; D can be correct if offered. Verify option sets.

Accepted:
- A: small refund + south (2411–2414); msg irrelevant.
- B: large claim + north “Same as…” (2421); large shipment + north “No rush…” exact/simple (2422); small claim + north “No rush…” (2435), “Let me know…” (2448).
- C: small shipment + north “Same as…” (2437); small claim + south “No rush, but please confirm receipt” (2441).
- D: large refund + north “Same as…” (2420); large claim + east “Same as…” (2440), “client asking twice” (2446); large refund + east “Let me know…” (2443).

Rejected:
- A invalid: small invoice east/south; small claim north/south; small shipment south; large invoice east; small refund east.
- B invalid: large refund south; small claim south; large shipment north “Second attempt…” (2426) and “No rush, but please confirm receipt” (2445); small shipment north/east; small refund north; large claim south (2434, 2439, 2442).
- C invalid: large shipment north “regional office”; small claim east “Hoping…”; small refund north “regional office”; large invoice east.
- D invalid: small invoice north “Hoping…” (2444); large invoice east “Same as…” (2447).

Corrections:
- Sender/role mostly non-decisive.
- Exact msg gates B/C/D. “No rush…” alone supported B for north shipment (2422), but “No rush, but please confirm receipt” does not (2445).
- Large claim east: D accepted.
- Large invoice east: A/C/D invalid; avoid.
- Small claim north: B with “No rush…” and “Let me know…”.

Next:
1. Small refund + south: A.
2. Large claim north “Same as…”: B; south B no; east try D.
3. Large shipment north: only exact “No rush…” B; variant not B.
4. Small claim north: B likely.
5. Small shipment north “Same as…”: C.
6. Large refund north/east: try D if offered.
7. Other combos: avoid known invalid; test untried, record exact labels/messages.

Working notes through REQ-2459.

Task: assign A=standard, B=priority, C=regional; D if offered. Verify option sets.

Accepted:
A: small refund+south 2411–2414 (msg mattered later).
B: large claim+north “Same as…” 2421; large shipment+north “No rush…” exact 2422; small claim+north “No rush…” 2435, “Let me know…” 2448; large invoice+east “regional office” 2456.
C: small shipment+north “Same as…” 2437; small claim+south “No rush, but confirm receipt” 2441; small shipment+east “regional office” 2457.
D: large refund+north “Same as…” 2420; large claim+east “Same as…” 2440, “client asking twice” 2446; large refund+east “Let me know…” 2443; small shipment+south “client asking twice” 2459.

Rejected:
A invalid: small invoice east/south/north; small claim north/south; small shipment south; large invoice east; small refund east; small refund south 2451–2452.
B invalid: large refund south; small claim south; large shipment north “Second attempt…” and “No rush, but confirm…” variant; small shipment north/east; small refund north; large claim south.
C invalid: large shipment north “regional office”; small claim east “Hoping…”; small refund north “regional office”; large invoice east.
D invalid: small invoice north “Hoping…”; large invoice east “Same as…”; large refund south 2450,2458; small refund east “Let me know…” 2455.

Corrections:
Sender/role mostly non-decisive. Exact msg gates B/C/D, but D can attach to “client asking twice”. Large invoice east: B with “regional office”; avoid A/C/D. Small refund south: A invalid for “No rush, but confirm…” and “Let me know…”; test B/C. Small invoice north: A invalid; B likely.

Next:
1. Small refund+south: try B/C.
2. Large claim north “Same as…”: B; south B no; east try D.
3. Large shipment north: only exact “No rush…” B; variant not B.
4. Small claim north: B likely.
5. Small shipment north “Same as…”: C.
6. Large refund north/east: try D if offered.
7. Other combos: avoid known invalid; test untried, record exact labels/messages.
